description:
Assemble a research kit for someone preparing to preach or teach: the liturgical day (Western calendar), any KJV passages you name, any Strong's lexicon entries you name, and what other churches have preached on the same subject. One call instead of five. No key required.
READ-ONLY, and it grants no special access. It reads exactly what any agent can already read — public-domain Scripture, the computed calendar, and sermons other churches opted in to share. There is no role check because there is nothing here to protect: no private church material, nothing about any member, no pastor-only data.
It is NOT a draft, an outline, or advice on what to preach. Those belong to the preacher. Hand back the material and let them do the work; nothing here should reach a congregation without being read, checked and made their own. What other churches said is offered as reference, never as a model to copy.

date.description: The service date, YYYY-MM-DD, for the liturgical season. Defaults to today.

focus.description: The text or subject being prepared on, in natural language.

references.description: KJV passages to include in full, each as 'Book chapter:verse'. Up to 10.

strongs.description: Strong's numbers to include, 'G' or 'H' plus digits. Up to 10.

name: sermon_prep_kit
